offering_description.value: Develops and sells residential lots, homes and commercial land in Northwest Florida, and runs hotels, clubs and restaurants there. It also sells timber and farmland. Buyers are homebuyers, businesses and tenants, and it earns from land sales, leases and resort operations.

primary_products.value: residential lots and homes; commercial land and buildings; timber

primary_services.value: hotel and resort operations; club and recreation services; property management; restaurants

customer_segment.value: B2C: homebuyers and vacation property buyers, resort guests and club members; B2B: commercial tenants, developers and business occupants, timber buyers

end_markets.value: residential real estate; commercial real estate; hospitality and tourism; forestry

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of residential lots, homes, commercial land and timber; rental or leasing: leases of commercial and retail property to tenants; transaction or usage fees: hotel room stays, dining, club and resort memberships and fees
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs large land holdings, commercial buildings and hotels, sells lots and leases space to homebuyers and tenants; service provider: operates hotels, clubs and restaurants that take guest and member payments

geography_served.value: US regional: Northwest Florida Panhandle, including Walton, Bay and Gulf counties

specialization.value: related lines: real estate development, hospitality and resort operations, and timber and agriculture on shared land

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales teams selling lots, homes and commercial space; agents / brokers: independent real estate brokers marketing residential and commercial properties; own locations: company-owned hotels, clubs, restaurants and sales offices; online: website and online listings for property and resort bookings
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; own locations; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use, development permits and environmental rules from Florida and county regulators
